reviews.text: Excellent all around: nice staff, facilities are clean, dogs love it, reasonably priced. Highly recommend.

This is the best place around to take your dogs for daycare, boarding, and grooming. Dani, Kelly and Tanner (and several others) are so amazing & our pups are always so excited to see them when working at “Bigs.” And Kara has definitely created the best daycare and boarding place we’ve ever had the privilege to send our babies. Thanks very much for everything, everybody!
Just was doing a job there. But the place looked well maintained

I was recommended to Kara's by my sister in law who is a dog whisperer.  What a great experience for my chihuahua Diego who will register vote and for the draft this November!  If you are a first timer, plan your evaluation at least 2 weeks before your first board/daycare.....

My dog goes here and he comes home tired every single day! And he has a LOT of energy. They always post pictures of all the dogs playing all the time on instagram and facebook and they always look like they’re having a blast!! Anytime i’ve ever had my dog bathed he’s always come out smelling so clean and feeling so soft! There’s no kennels or cages here so the dogs roam free all day and play all day! They can be inside or outside whichever they choose and there’s always someone with them! Love love love Kara’s and will forever take my dogs here!!

We are a military family who knew no one in SATX when we got stationed there. I found Kara’s at random and could not have been happier with their care of our lab Foster. Kara and her staff went above and beyond to provide daycare and boarding services to Foster. They were flexible, affordable, and most importantly did an exceptional job in caring for our dog. Foster loved going to daycare there. We treat our dog like our child, and do not trust him to just anyone. I write this review to tell you in no uncertain terms you can trust, and should trust Kara and her staff with the care of your dog! You’ll be happy you did!

I’ve never been let down! Kara’s is absolutely the top choice for day care and boarding. Kara and her team genuinely love every dog, and it shows in everything they do. The staff is friendly, skilled, and always ready to assist. They just keep getting better! Thrilled to have been boarding and using day care since 2016! ❤️
Bad management.. Women only !!! Guys don't waste your time.

I was considering writing this review for a while, because I really really liked this place. Was bringing my pup since he was little for proper socializing and dogs play. Everything was really good when he was with medium dogs, but ever since they transferred him to the bigs it became a nightmare. Staff who worked there for a while are good and experienced, the problem is, it is either new hires can't really handle dogs due to the lack of the experience or they are understaffed.

The first accident happened when I dropped my puppy. I am picking him up and noticing his tongue is split. No blood, so it was injured for a while. After I got home my puppy was super thirsty and drank 2 bowls of water.  Whoever called me said my pup is a jumper and he gets anxious when I leave. And I mean, it is true, and I DO NOT blame them for this accident, even tho I am still concerned about the accident where one dog snapped another dog which I was told about and never got access to the cameras. What really gets me off I was never called regarding injury. If my dog is bleeding and he tore apart his tongue give me a call?? So I can take care of my puppy??

I've decided to try it for more time, because well accidents happen, and I was assured they will look carefully after him because of this accident. Jesus that was a really bad idea. I am picking up my puppy and the nightmare begins. He started to throw up once we came home and had a massive diarrhea, refusing to drink or eat (He is food motivated, never happened to him). He is barely moving. Went to the urgent care care twice. Luckily, the X-ray didn't show up on anything inside. A lot of tests, scans and a lot of gases inside him which made him in extreme pain with a bloody diarrhea. It was a rough month of rehabilitation. I contacted Kara K9 regarding this accident and they have been really nice, got several calls asking how my pup is doing.

It is a good place if your dog is not a high energy one and more like a social butterfly, however, if your dog more "person oriented", it is better to search for another place. It seems like they are getting a lot of dogs now and can't handle everything.
My dogs have the best time at Kara’s and love the staff members! They are so excited to go each day.

I took my dog to Kara’s for boarding for nine days. When I got her home, I noticed her fur was covered in blood. Panicking, I rushed her to the vet, and they found a deep cut.

I called Kara’s to find out what happened because no one had told me anything, and they didn’t even seem to know it had happened. The owner checked the cameras and told me another dog had bitten her.

What really got to me was how the owner reacted. She didn’t seem to care at all. Instead of apologizing or showing any concern, she just said that taking my dog there is always a risk and that things like this can happen. It felt like she was more interested in defending herself than addressing what happened or showing any empathy for my dog.
Fantastic facility, clean, well maintained, friendly staff & dogs love it!

Best Daycare Best Boarding in town.  It is doggie heaven.  We were looking for a cage free boarding and Kara's popped up.  I instantly felt like this was the best place for my dogs.  The owner is AMAZING and made us feel like we have known her forever.  Never will I ever take out dogs anywhere else!

I have been taking Fred to Kara's for over 2 years now. It's the only daycare/boarding I trust! They have the best staff and Kara is wonderful. Fred loves going to play during the day, and I love that they do not crate him for boarding. Kara's is the best!
Amazing place. So kind and attentive. Kara and the staff love our boys. 5/5.
No groomer on staff.

I love Kara’s! Only daycare I trust for my dogs. Love  the staff and also other services offered (boarding, grooming, and taxi service). I also appreciate how they have a trial day to make sure all dogs get along. Thank you Kara’s and staff

A really great place for our pups (and us!).  The owners and staff are all amazing and take great care of our dogs.  Truly a first class operation all the way around, where I know my dogs will be safe, be well cared for, get their medicine on time, and also get plenty of love and have fun times!

I wouldn't leave my animal(s) here for any reason, solely due to the owner's terrible attitude and unprofessional behavior I witnessed towards employees. I also know that the owner blows a head gasket if the air conditioning is turned below 73° which if you have a husky or other heat sensitive breed is terrible because, well Texas. I will be contacting the better business bureau as well as labor enforcement on this business due to the treatment I saw the employees endure and again, I'd never leave an animal here.
Worth every penny. The staff is fantastic with both dogs and people. A+++!
My dogs love it here!
I have been taking my dog Camila for about 8 years now! We love this place, and Camila loves it as well. I love that it is cage-free. The customer service is amazing! :)
